Client planning / 06 November 2026

PHASE 1 · SHOPIFY PARTS STORE

NORO USA

Store structure.
Product discovery.
A clear path to purchase.

A practical plan for the U.S. parts store, built around standard Shopify shopping patterns.

Prepared for Mike Higginbotham
Recommended direction for review

01 / Project direction

The store we are planning

A public parts store with a familiar B2C buying experience, serving installers, machine builders and other U.S. buyers.

Keep the corporate website

norousa.com remains on WordPress. Add a “Parts” link to the new Shopify store.

Create a separate Shopify store

Noro owns the store and subscriptions. noroparts.com is the proposed domain; domain selection is still Mike’s decision.

Sell eligible parts directly

Show prices publicly. Let customers select a part, add it to the cart and check out without registering.

Make support easy to reach

Use a separate inquiry route for freight exceptions, technical questions and larger system projects.

No account approval or login gate before browsing, adding to cart or checkout.

02 / Buyer tasks

Three ways to find a part

01

“I know my material and diameter.”

Shop by Material → diameter filter → category → product.

Make this the main browsing route from the homepage.

02

“I need a particular type of fitting.”

Shop Parts → category → material and diameter → product.

Keep direct category access in the main menu.

03

“I have the part number.”

Search by SKU → correct product and variant → cart.

Keep search visible and show the selected SKU on the product page.

Material → diameter → category guides discovery; it is not a compulsory step-by-step wizard.

03 / Reference store

What we take from the German store

Observed in the German storeDecision for the U.S. store
Technical product families and multiple size variants.Use family-based product pages, with clear size choices and specifications.
Material, connection and other technical filters; some material labels remain in German.Use consistent U.S. English labels. Prioritize material, diameter and category.
Login requested before adding products to the cart.Keep the catalog, cart and guest checkout open.
German-market availability and commercial context.Use Noro-approved USD prices and explain Germany-to-U.S. fulfillment.

Reference: public homepage and product listing. The U.S. store follows Noro USA’s identity and operating rules.

05 / Category structure

Seven categories, one catalog

Customer-facing categoryWhat belongs here
PipesStraight tubing and pipe families
Elbows & SegmentsDirectional fittings and segments
ConnectorsConnection parts, seal rings and O-rings
ReducersTransitions between different diameters
AdaptersTransitions between connection forms
RegulatorsFlow-control components
AccessoriesOther supporting components

Keep material and diameter out of the category tree

They are filters across the catalog, rather than repeated category branches.

Make seals easy to find

Expose Seal Rings and O-Rings as direct links under Connectors.

The seven groups come from the onboarding’s Rev1 summary. Final SKU assignments require a sheet review.

07 / Findability

Navigation and filters

Shop PartsShop by MaterialSystem Design & SupportHelpSearch / Cart

  1. Material / FinishUse plain English labels with one consistent spelling.
  2. DiameterSort numerically. Preserve actual catalog units and nominal sizing.
  3. CategoryOffer the seven part families within the current selection.
  4. Relevant technical detailsConnection type; length, angle, radius or second diameter where applicable.

Standard Shopify controls

Use Search & Discovery and the theme’s collection/search filters.

Show result counts, removable selections and a clear reset. Use a filter panel on mobile.

Keep material and diameter when narrowing by category within the listing.

Filter counts represent matching products, not stock or SKU quantity. Theme behavior and variant matching require real-product validation.

08 / Catalog model

Product families and variants

One product familyPart geometry + material / finish + connection system

Let size differences become variants

Use diameter and applicable length or wall thickness as options. Each sellable variant retains its own SKU, USD price, stock and weight.

Separate a family if its choices become difficult to understand or exceed standard option limits.

Reducers need two diameters

Label large-end and small-end diameter separately. Both must resolve to the same valid variant.

Store specifications as structured data

Display relevant fields in a concise table. Hide non-applicable dimensions.

Keep seal materials accurate

A seal’s material is different from the pipe material. Do not classify a seal as steel to make it appear in a steel filter.

The model is recommended; exact SKU grouping will be checked against Rev1 before theme implementation.

09 / Homepage

Homepage content hierarchy

01

Store purpose + Shop Parts

Identify what Noro sells and give visitors a direct route into the catalog.

02

Shop by Material

Make the client’s preferred buying order the first browsing option.

03

Shop by Category

Show seven recognizable product families with clear images.

04

Selection guidance

Explain material, diameter and connection checks in a short guide.

05

System support + delivery context

Introduce Noro’s project support and explain that parts ship from Germany.

Keep search and shopping visible before long company information. Use Noro USA branding and approved service claims.

10 / Product listing

The collection page

Above the products

  • Clear category or search heading.
  • Material, diameter and category filters in that order.
  • Visible active selections, result count and sorting.
  • A compact mobile filter panel.

When there are no results

Offer a filter reset, alternative category links and product-selection support.

On each product card

  • Recognizable image and plain product name.
  • Material / finish and key connection or size details.
  • Approved USD price; “From” only when variants differ.
  • Choose Options for products requiring a size selection.
  • A clear inquiry action for products requiring review.

Avoid adding an unconfirmed diameter to the cart from the listing. A visible size choice comes first.

Show both diameters for reducers. Keep seals accessible through Connectors even when pipe-material filters would exclude them.

11 / Product detail

The product page

The purchase area

  1. Product identityName, material / finish, connection type and selected SKU.
  2. Exact variantDiameter and applicable size options. Update price and availability with the selection.
  3. Purchase decisionUSD price per unit, quantity, availability and Add to Cart.
  4. Delivery and helpGermany-to-U.S. shipping information and a contextual support link.

Evidence below the purchase area

Technical table, dimensional drawing and relevant product documents.

Images by product family

Use static renders for distinct geometries and materials. Add size-specific images only when proportions materially differ.

Consistent square images; suggested source size 2048 × 2048 px. Noro supplies and matches final assets.

No unverified compatibility claims. Related seals or connectors are suggested only after Noro confirms suitability.

12 / Purchase flow

Cart, checkout and inquiries

Selected variant→Cart review→Guest checkout

Standard purchase

Show SKU, selected dimensions, unit price and quantity in the cart. Allow edits and removal.

Use Shopify checkout and Noro’s approved payment provider. Accounts remain optional.

No agreed quantity discounts or automated duty pricing are added to the plan.

Human inquiry

Use for unconfirmed purchase conditions, special freight and larger system projects.

Carry the product link and SKU into the form. Ask for quantity and delivery ZIP when needed.

Route the request to Noro’s approved contact; no automated quote is generated.

Eligible parts use Add to Cart. Exceptions explain why a review is needed and give the customer a useful next step.

13 / Theme selection

Shopify theme recommendation

PREFERRED PAID CANDIDATE

Warehouse

$320 USD by Maestrooo

Designed for large catalogs. Its collection navigation, search, filtering and product tabs fit the needs of a technical parts store.

View Warehouse in the Theme Store ↗

NO-LICENSE-COST ALTERNATIVE

Dawn

Free by Shopify

A simpler standard foundation. Add the technical fields and contextual inquiry behavior through focused theme adjustments.

View Dawn in the Theme Store ↗

Trial Warehouse and Dawn with the same pipe, reducer and connector samples. Select after mobile filters, SKU search and variant behavior pass.

Recommendation, not a purchase or client sign-off. Theme price checked 06 November 2026. Mike approves paid theme/app charges separately.

Delivery stages and support

AFTER PLAN APPROVAL

Design

*Original planning allowance; the added rough prototype should be included when confirming the stage estimate. Timing starts when inputs, payment and approvals are ready. No fixed launch date is committed.

Parts discovery, direct purchase and clear human support.

Separate future scope

Parts-list uploads, competitor matching, configurators, automatic quotes, stock/price automation and interactive 3D.
